answer: Expiring work credits stop sybil farms from stockpiling identities. An alias earns credits only from verified completed work, and each credit lapses after 6 epochs unless the alias keeps finishing real jobs. Each epoch, falcon auditors sweep the ledger and delete lapsed credits, so a farm of 100 aliases that wander idle holds zero credits on pay day. The task garden lists only aliases with live credits, and one alias caught faking a job loses every credit and sits out 10 epochs.
